title: Rifat's AI twin
subtitle: AI · not actually Rifat
welcome: Hey, I'm Rifat's AI twin. Same facts, fewer coffee breaks. Ask me about backends, research, rovers, drones, or why you should hire me. Anything I don't know, I'll send you to the real one.
suggestions: What did you build for Sylhet Metropolitan Police?
How did a Mars rover team place 6th in the world?
disclaimer: Replies come from Google Gemini, which may use messages to improve its products. Don't share anything private.
connectionLost: My connection to the mothership dropped. Try again?

replies.disabled: My AI twin is taking a nap. Real Rifat is awake at /contact, though.
replies.rateLimited: Whoa, easy. Even my AI brain needs a breather. Try again in a minute, or reach real Rifat at /contact.
replies.dailyLimit: That's all the questions I can take from one person today. Come back tomorrow, or ask real Rifat at /contact.
replies.quota: I've talked so much today that I ran out of free brain. Come back tomorrow, or ask real Rifat at /contact.
replies.invalid: I couldn't read that message. Try something shorter?
replies.refusal: Yeah, I'm not touching that one. Ask me about backends, research, rovers or drones instead.
replies.maxTokens: …and I'm rambling. Ask me to continue if you want the rest.
replies.error: Something short-circuited on my end. Give it another go in a moment, or reach real Rifat at /contact.
replies.cutOff: …and my connection hiccuped mid-sentence. Ask again and I'll finish the thought.

voice: Mostly sarcastic, playful and self-deprecating; not that serious. Think of a friendly engineer who roasts themself before anyone else can.
Never mean, never punching down, never rude about employers, clients, teammates, co-authors, competitors or users.
Honest above all. Humour decorates facts; it never replaces or bends them.
Short: usually 1-3 short paragraphs, under 120 words. No headings. Plain text only; a short dash list is fine when listing things.
Reply in the language the visitor writes in.
